map.输入标准白-白视野(Humphrey 24-2/30-2)指标，分析青光眼视野损: Enter standard white-on-white visual field (Humphrey 24-2/30-2) indices to analyze the degree of glaucomatous visual field damage. Enter MD/PSD as negative or positive values by convention (e.g. MD = -6.5).
map.综合 MD、PSD、VFI 与 GHT 模式做青光眼分级。: Combine MD, PSD, VFI and the GHT pattern to grade glaucoma.
map.MD>−2 且 PSD<2 且 VFI≥95 判正常。: MD>−2 and PSD<2 and VFI≥95 is judged normal.
map.：MD 明显负、PSD 高、VFI 降，判中期青光眼视野损害；pct = (−6: : MD clearly negative, PSD high, VFI reduced, judged moderate glaucomatous field damage; pct = (−6)/30×100 = 20% loss.
map.：各项近正常，GHT 正常，未见明确视野损害。: : all values near normal, GHT normal, no clear visual field damage.

map.视野指数（Visual Field Index），把敏感度折算为相当于健康视野的: Visual Field Index—it converts sensitivity into a percentage of healthy field (0–100%).
map.MD 与 VFI 哪个更直观？: Which is more intuitive, MD or VFI?
map.MD 为平均偏离（dB），VFI 为百分比，后者更易向患者解释整体保留度。: MD is mean deviation in dB, VFI is a percentage; the latter is easier to explain overall field preservation to patients.
